reviewItem.question: Does "Fixed Allow for re-executions of istio-iptables by skipping apply step if existing rules are compatible" mean a change to protocol-behavior:istio|name=iptables-reexecution-skip-compatible-rules|component=istio-iptables (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: istio-iptables re-executions now skip the apply step when existing iptables rules are compatible.
